_what: The hand-written sets whose completeness is not defined, each with why (openspec/specs/governance/ GOV-3). A set named here is open: a heuristic sample, not a vocabulary anything outside it states in full. tools/audit_derived_sets.py writes each reason into tests/derived-sets.json, and tests/test_derived_sets.py refuses an unread set with no reason here, a reason for a set that is not unread, and an empty reason. A closed set gets a derivation or a reader instead, never a line here.
anchor_text_audit.GENERIC_ANCHORS: generic link phrasings, a sample in one language; a phrasing it lacks is read as descriptive
answer_block_scanner.NON_PROSE: elements whose text is skipped as not prose; HTML defines no such category
answer_block_scanner.BLOCK_TAGS: the boundaries of a text block, a judgment across HTML's flow and phrasing content, which shares elements between them
answer_block_scanner.ANSWER_TAGS: the elements an answer may be written in, this scanner's choice
audit_item_semantics.STOP: stopwords for comparing a title with what its assertion reads
audit_thresholds.ARITHMETIC: literals read as arithmetic rather than thresholds, a convention of this tool
cache_compression_checker.STATIC_EXTENSI: asset extensions sampled for cache headers
calibrate_css_minification.PACKAGES: the calibration corpus, chosen and pinned
calibrate_font_weight.PACKAGES: the calibration corpus, chosen and pinned
calibrate_serp_length.FONT_FILES: the fonts a calibration measures with, chosen
calibrate_serp_length.COMPOSITION_MIXES: text compositions a calibration tries, chosen
calibrate_serp_length.SURFACES: result surfaces a calibration tries, with the pixel budgets it states
checklist_runner.NOT_FOUND_PHRASES: soft-404 wordings, a sample in eight languages
detect_profile.PLATFORM_SIGNALS: platform fingerprints, a sample with weights
detect_profile.PATH_SIGNALS: URL path fingerprints, a sample with weights
detect_profile.MARKUP_SIGNALS: markup fingerprints, a sample with weights
gsc_links_csv.SITE_SHEETS: sheet names of a Search Console export, by locale, a sample
gsc_links_csv.ANCHOR_SHEETS: sheet names of a Search Console export, by locale, a sample
gsc_links_csv.PAGE_SHEETS: sheet names of a Search Console export, by locale, a sample
image_weight_audit.MODERN_FORMATS: the formats credited as next-generation, a convention; browsers do not agree on JPEG XL
image_weight_audit.RASTER_FORMATS: the formats named as replaceable by a modern one, the common ones
local_seo_checker.GBP_PATTERNS: business profile link hosts, a sample
probe_shapes.CTX: the context one probe run passes, a value rather than a vocabulary
safe_http.DEFAULT_HEADERS: the request this tool sends, a choice
safe_http._TRUE: spellings of yes in an environment variable; any other reads no, so it fails closed
security_headers.SECURITY_HEADERS: the headers this tool scores and their weights, a selection
seo_common.XML_CTYPES: content types a sitemap is accepted under, wider than XML's because servers mislabel
seo_common.BYLINE_CLASS_TOKENS: class names authors are marked with, a sample
seo_common.HEAD_REFUSED_STATUSES: statuses after which HEAD is retried as GET: RFC 9110's two method refusals (its basis line) and 403, a firewall's refusal of HEAD; no document lists every status a server answers HEAD with instead of the resource
seo_common.SUBJECT_KEYS: properties whose subtree is the page's subject rather than its own, a judgment schema.org does not make
server_log_audit.JSON_KEYS: field names across log formats, a sample
